service.description:
Run a 6-DOF robot TCP waypoint planner using a DJL ONNX model.
The model accepts [tcp_start(6) || tcp_goal(6)] (12 inputs) and produces N_WAYPOINTS x 6 TCP poses (flat output), aligned with the PLC waypoint space used by PLCopen Part 4 coordinated-motion FBs such as MC_MoveLinearAbsolute and MC_MoveCircularAbsolute.
Persists results to: Vector / VectorComponent — per-waypoint TCP poses + tcp_start/tcp_goal ApproximatedFunction — parent function container ParametricPath — path-level metadata Trajectory — time-tagged motion ApproximatedFunctionSample — one sample per waypoint ParametricPathPoint — path point per sample TrajectoryPoint — time offset per sample MathModelRun — execution record MathModelPerf — latency / throughput counters MathModelData — links model to trajectory + input vectors
The ONNX model file is resolved from MathModelDefContent.contentLocation (e.g. component://moqui-device/data/ml/trajectory_planner.onnx). The current bundled model must be retrained/exported in the same TCP pose space (X,Y,Z,A,B,C) to match this service contract.

parameter.name: mathModelId
parameter.description: ID of the MathModel instance to use for inference.

parameter.name: startPose
parameter.description: 6 TCP pose values [X,Y,Z,A,B,C] — start pose in the same space used by the PLC.

parameter.name: goalPose
parameter.description: 6 TCP pose values [X,Y,Z,A,B,C] — goal pose in the same space used by the PLC.
